shared_elements: schematic linear engravings on a rock surface
small human/anthropomorphic figures rendered as simplified shapes
repeated small motifs organised in roughly horizontal rows/registers
justification: Both surfaces carry densely packed, schematic incised forms including small simplified human figures laid out in broadly horizontal bands, and both use repeated short strokes as a filling device. But the actual content differs entirely: A depicts narrative pictorial imagery (crewed boats with hull-and-stroke crew lines, a raised-arm figure, a large ladder/grid motif) while B is a regimented sequence of standardised script signs (birds, limbs, vessels, geometric glyphs) in ruled lines, with no scene, no interaction between figures and no compositional focus of the kind A shows.
